q.en: What does 'AI' stand for?
q.hi: 'AI' ka full form kya hai?
q.mr: 'AI' चे पूर्ण रूप काय आहे?

en: Algorithmic Integration
Artificial Intelligence
Advanced Interface
Automated Internet
hi: Algorithmic Integration
Artificial Intelligence
Advanced Interface
Automated Internet
mr: Algorithmic Integration
Artificial Intelligence
Advanced Interface
Automated Internet

exp.en: AI = Artificial Intelligence: computer systems that perform tasks that normally need human intelligence, like understanding language, recognising images or making predictions.
exp.hi: AI = Artificial Intelligence: aise computer systems jo woh kaam karte hain jinke liye normally human intelligence chahiye, jaise language samajhna, images pehchanna ya predictions karna.
exp.mr: AI = Artificial Intelligence: अशी computer systems जी सामान्यतः मानवी बुद्धी लागणारी कामे करतात, जसे भाषा समजणे, images ओळखणे किंवा predictions करणे.

q.en: Which of these tasks is an example of generative AI?
q.hi: Inmein se kaunsa task generative AI ka example hai?
q.mr: यापैकी कोणते काम generative AI चे उदाहरण आहे?

en: Writing a fresh Instagram caption from a prompt
Adding up a month's sales column in an Excel sheet
Showing a website's page views in a GA4 report
Sorting inbox emails by the date they arrived
hi: Prompt se fresh Instagram caption likhna
Excel sheet mein mahine ki sales ka column add karna
GA4 report mein website ke page views dikhana
Inbox emails ko aane ki date se sort karna
mr: Prompt वरून नवीन Instagram caption लिहिणे
Excel sheet मध्ये महिन्याच्या sales चा column बेरीज करणे
GA4 report मध्ये website चे page views दाखवणे
Inbox मधील emails आलेल्या तारखेनुसार sort करणे

exp.en: Generative AI creates new content (text, images, audio, video) from a prompt. Summing numbers, sorting or reporting metrics are ordinary software functions, not generation.
exp.hi: Generative AI prompt se naya content (text, image, audio, video) banata hai. Numbers add karna, sort karna ya metrics report karna normal software ka kaam hai, generation nahi.
exp.mr: Generative AI prompt वरून नवीन content (text, image, audio, video) तयार करते. आकडे बेरीज करणे, sort करणे किंवा metrics दाखवणे हे साधे software चे काम आहे, generation नाही.

q.en: Claude is an AI assistant made by which company?
q.hi: Claude AI assistant kis company ne banaya hai?
q.mr: Claude हा AI assistant कोणत्या कंपनीने बनवला आहे?

en: Anthropic
Meta
Microsoft
Amazon
hi: Anthropic
Meta
Microsoft
Amazon
mr: Anthropic
Meta
Microsoft
Amazon

exp.en: Claude is built by Anthropic, an AI safety and research company. GPT/ChatGPT comes from OpenAI, Gemini from Google and Llama from Meta.
exp.hi: Claude ko Anthropic ne banaya hai, jo ek AI safety aur research company hai. GPT/ChatGPT OpenAI ka hai, Gemini Google ka aur Llama Meta ka.
exp.mr: Claude हा Anthropic ने बनवला आहे, जी एक AI safety आणि research कंपनी आहे. GPT/ChatGPT OpenAI चे, Gemini Google चे आणि Llama Meta चे आहे.

q.en: Gemini is a family of AI models from which company?
q.hi: Gemini AI models kis company ke hain?
q.mr: Gemini हे AI models कोणत्या कंपनीचे आहेत?

en: OpenAI
Apple
Google
Anthropic
hi: OpenAI
Apple
Google
Anthropic
mr: OpenAI
Apple
Google
Anthropic

exp.en: Gemini is Google's family of multimodal AI models, also used inside Google products. OpenAI makes GPT and Anthropic makes Claude.
exp.hi: Gemini Google ka multimodal AI models ka family hai, jo Google ke products mein bhi use hota hai. OpenAI GPT banata hai aur Anthropic Claude.
exp.mr: Gemini हे Google चे multimodal AI models चे family आहे, जे Google च्या products मध्येही वापरले जाते. OpenAI GPT बनवते आणि Anthropic Claude.

q.en: The Llama family of openly available AI models is released by which company?
q.hi: Llama naam ke openly available AI models kaunsi company release karti hai?
q.mr: Llama नावाचे openly available AI models कोणती कंपनी release करते?

en: Adobe
Anthropic
Meta
Google
hi: Adobe
Anthropic
Meta
Google
mr: Adobe
Anthropic
Meta
Google

exp.en: Llama is Meta's family of large language models whose weights are made available for download, so developers can run and customise them on their own servers.
exp.hi: Llama Meta ka LLM family hai jiske model weights download ke liye available hain, isliye developers inhe apne servers pe chala aur customise kar sakte hain.
exp.mr: Llama हे Meta चे LLM family आहे ज्याचे model weights download साठी उपलब्ध आहेत, त्यामुळे developers ते स्वतःच्या servers वर चालवू आणि customise करू शकतात.

q.en: What is a chatbot?
q.hi: Chatbot kya hota hai?
q.mr: Chatbot म्हणजे काय?

en: A support agent who replies to customer chats manually
A tool that blocks spam messages in WhatsApp groups
A browser plugin that makes websites load faster
Software that chats with users by text or voice
hi: Support agent jo customer chats ka manually reply karta hai
Tool jo WhatsApp groups mein spam messages block karta hai
Browser plugin jo websites ko fast load karwata hai
Software jo users se text ya voice mein chat karta hai
mr: Customer chats ला manually उत्तर देणारा support agent
WhatsApp groups मधील spam messages block करणारे tool
Websites लवकर load करणारे browser plugin
Users शी text किंवा voice मधून chat करणारे software

exp.en: A chatbot is software that converses with people. Older ones follow fixed rules; modern ones like Claude or ChatGPT use LLMs to understand and reply in natural language.
exp.hi: Chatbot ek software hai jo logon se baat karta hai. Purane chatbots fixed rules follow karte the; aaj ke Claude ya ChatGPT jaise chatbots LLM use karke natural language mein reply karte hain.
exp.mr: Chatbot हे लोकांशी संवाद साधणारे software आहे. जुने chatbots ठराविक rules पाळायचे; आजचे Claude किंवा ChatGPT सारखे chatbots LLM वापरून नैसर्गिक भाषेत उत्तर देतात.

q.en: What is Machine Learning (ML)?
q.hi: Machine Learning (ML) kya hai?
q.mr: Machine Learning (ML) म्हणजे काय?

en: Software that can only run on very large supercomputers
Teaching people how to operate computers and laptops
Robots that repair and maintain machines in factories
Systems that learn patterns from data, not fixed rules
hi: Software jo sirf bahut bade supercomputers pe chalta hai
Logon ko computers aur laptops chalana sikhana
Robots jo factories mein machines repair aur maintain karte hain
Systems jo fixed rules nahi, data se patterns seekhte hain
mr: फक्त खूप मोठ्या supercomputers वर चालणारे software
लोकांना computers आणि laptops चालवायला शिकवणे
Factories मध्ये machines दुरुस्त आणि देखभाल करणारे robots
ठराविक rules ऐवजी data मधून patterns शिकणाऱ्या systems

exp.en: Machine Learning is a part of AI where systems learn patterns from example data (e.g. past purchases) and use them to make predictions, rather than following only hand-written rules.
exp.hi: Machine Learning AI ka hissa hai jismein system example data (jaise past purchases) se patterns seekhta hai aur predictions karta hai, sirf haath se likhe rules follow nahi karta.
exp.mr: Machine Learning हा AI चा भाग आहे ज्यात system उदाहरण data (उदा. past purchases) मधून patterns शिकते आणि predictions करते, फक्त हाताने लिहिलेले rules पाळत नाही.

q.en: What does a 'text-to-image' AI tool do?
q.hi: 'Text-to-image' AI tool kya karta hai?
q.mr: 'Text-to-image' AI tool काय करते?

en: Adds captions under existing images automatically
Reads and extracts the text printed inside a photo
Converts an image file into an editable PDF
Creates a new image from a written description
hi: Existing images ke neeche automatically captions lagata hai
Photo ke andar chhapa text padh ke nikaalta hai
Image file ko editable PDF mein convert karta hai
Likhe description se nayi image banata hai
mr: आधीच्या images खाली आपोआप captions लावते
Photo मध्ये छापलेला text वाचून बाहेर काढते
Image file ला editable PDF मध्ये बदलते
लिहिलेल्या वर्णनावरून नवीन image तयार करते

exp.en: Text-to-image models generate a brand-new picture from a prompt like 'a Diwali gift hamper on a wooden table'. Reading text inside a photo is OCR, a different task.
exp.hi: Text-to-image model prompt se bilkul nayi picture banata hai, jaise 'wooden table pe Diwali gift hamper'. Photo ke andar ka text padhna OCR hai, woh alag kaam hai.
exp.mr: Text-to-image model prompt वरून पूर्णपणे नवीन चित्र तयार करते, उदा. 'लाकडी टेबलावर Diwali gift hamper'. Photo मधील text वाचणे म्हणजे OCR, ते वेगळे काम आहे.

q.en: Deep learning is a type of machine learning that mainly uses…
q.hi: Deep learning machine learning ka ek type hai jo mainly kya use karta hai?
q.mr: Deep learning हा machine learning चा प्रकार आहे जो मुख्यतः काय वापरतो?

en: Simple if-else rules written by hand
Spreadsheets with pivot tables
Neural networks with many layers
Keyword lists typed by marketers
hi: Haath se likhe simple if-else rules
Pivot tables wali spreadsheets
Bahut saari layers wale neural networks
Marketers ki type ki hui keyword lists
mr: हाताने लिहिलेले साधे if-else rules
Pivot tables असलेल्या spreadsheets
अनेक layers असलेले neural networks
Marketers ने टाइप केलेल्या keyword lists

exp.en: Deep learning uses neural networks with many ('deep') layers. It powers image recognition, speech recognition and modern LLMs.
exp.hi: Deep learning bahut saari ('deep') layers wale neural networks use karta hai. Image recognition, speech recognition aur aaj ke LLMs isi pe chalte hain.
exp.mr: Deep learning अनेक ('deep') layers असलेले neural networks वापरते. Image recognition, speech recognition आणि आजचे LLMs यावरच चालतात.

q.en: Which statement about AI, Machine Learning (ML) and Deep Learning (DL) is correct?
q.hi: AI, Machine Learning (ML) aur Deep Learning (DL) ke baare mein kaunsa statement sahi hai?
q.mr: AI, Machine Learning (ML) आणि Deep Learning (DL) बद्दल कोणते विधान बरोबर आहे?

en: DL is older and broader than AI
DL is part of ML, and ML is part of AI
ML and DL are unrelated to AI
AI is part of ML, and ML is part of DL
hi: DL, AI se purana aur bada field hai
DL, ML ka hissa hai aur ML, AI ka hissa hai
ML aur DL ka AI se koi relation nahi
AI, ML ka hissa hai aur ML, DL ka hissa hai
mr: DL हे AI पेक्षा जुने आणि मोठे क्षेत्र आहे
DL हा ML चा भाग आहे आणि ML हा AI चा भाग आहे
ML आणि DL चा AI शी काही संबंध नाही
AI हा ML चा भाग आहे आणि ML हा DL चा भाग आहे

exp.en: Think of nested circles: AI is the broadest field, ML is one way to build AI (learning from data), and DL is a type of ML that uses many-layered neural networks.
exp.hi: Nested circles socho: AI sabse bada field hai, ML AI banane ka ek tareeka hai (data se seekhna), aur DL ML ka ek type hai jo multi-layer neural networks use karta hai.
exp.mr: एकात एक वर्तुळे समजा: AI हे सर्वात मोठे क्षेत्र, ML हा AI बनवण्याचा एक मार्ग (data मधून शिकणे), आणि DL हा ML चा प्रकार जो अनेक layers चे neural networks वापरतो.

q.en: What makes 'supervised learning' different from other types of ML?
q.hi: 'Supervised learning' baaki ML types se kaise alag hai?
q.mr: 'Supervised learning' इतर ML प्रकारांपेक्षा वेगळे कसे आहे?

en: It works without needing any training data at all
A human watches the model every second while it runs
It learns from labelled examples with known answers
It can only be used for generating images and video
hi: Yeh bina kisi training data ke hi kaam karta hai
Model chalte waqt ek insaan use har second dekhta hai
Yeh known answers wale labelled examples se seekhta hai
Yeh sirf images aur video generate karne ke kaam aata hai
mr: हे कोणत्याही training data शिवायच काम करते
Model चालू असताना एक व्यक्ती त्यावर प्रत्येक सेकंद लक्ष ठेवते
हे माहीत उत्तरे असलेल्या labelled उदाहरणांमधून शिकते
हे फक्त images आणि video तयार करण्यासाठी वापरले जाते

exp.en: In supervised learning, training data has labels, e.g. past leads marked 'converted' or 'not converted'. The model learns to predict the label for new cases. 'Supervised' does not mean live human monitoring.
exp.hi: Supervised learning mein training data pe labels hote hain, jaise past leads pe 'converted' ya 'not converted'. Model naye cases ke liye label predict karna seekhta hai. 'Supervised' ka matlab live human monitoring nahi hai.
exp.mr: Supervised learning मध्ये training data वर labels असतात, उदा. जुन्या leads वर 'converted' किंवा 'not converted'. Model नवीन cases साठी label predict करायला शिकते. 'Supervised' म्हणजे live मानवी देखरेख नाही.

q.en: What is a 'multimodal' AI model?
q.hi: 'Multimodal' AI model kya hota hai?
q.mr: 'Multimodal' AI model म्हणजे काय?

en: A model that is sold under several pricing plans
A model that is available in many Indian languages
A model that handles text, images and other data types
A model that runs on mobile phones, tablets and laptops alike
hi: Model jo kai pricing plans mein bikta ho
Model jo kai Indian languages mein available ho
Model jo text, images aur doosre data types handle kare
Model jo mobile, tablet aur laptop sab pe ek jaisa chale
mr: अनेक pricing plans मध्ये विकले जाणारे model
अनेक भारतीय भाषांमध्ये उपलब्ध असलेले model
Text, images आणि इतर data प्रकार हाताळणारे model
Mobile, tablet आणि laptop सगळ्यांवर सारखे चालणारे model

exp.en: 'Modality' means a type of data: text, image, audio, video. A multimodal model can, for example, look at a product photo and write an ad description for it.
exp.hi: 'Modality' matlab data ka type: text, image, audio, video. Multimodal model, jaise, product photo dekh ke uska ad description likh sakta hai.
exp.mr: 'Modality' म्हणजे data चा प्रकार: text, image, audio, video. Multimodal model उदा. product photo पाहून त्याचे ad description लिहू शकते.

q.en: What is 'prompt engineering'?
q.hi: 'Prompt engineering' kya hai?
q.mr: 'Prompt engineering' म्हणजे काय?

en: Designing and refining inputs to get better AI outputs
Engineering the GPU chips and servers that run AI models
Writing code that makes a website load faster
Repairing and maintaining broken chatbot servers
hi: Behtar AI output ke liye inputs design aur refine karna
AI models chalane wale GPU chips aur servers engineer karna
Website fast load karne ke liye code likhna
Kharab chatbot servers repair aur maintain karna
mr: चांगल्या AI output साठी inputs तयार करणे आणि सुधारणे
AI models चालवणाऱ्या GPU chips आणि servers तयार करणे
Website लवकर load व्हावी म्हणून code लिहिणे
बिघडलेले chatbot servers दुरुस्त आणि देखभाल करणे

exp.en: Prompt engineering means crafting clear prompts: context, goal, audience, examples, format and constraints, then testing and improving them until outputs are reliably good.
exp.hi: Prompt engineering matlab clear prompts banana: context, goal, audience, examples, format aur constraints dena, phir test karke improve karte rehna jab tak output consistently achha na aaye.
exp.mr: Prompt engineering म्हणजे स्पष्ट prompts तयार करणे: context, goal, audience, examples, format आणि constraints देणे, आणि output सातत्याने चांगले येईपर्यंत test करून सुधारणे.

q.en: Why should a marketer fact-check facts and numbers written by an AI chatbot?
q.hi: Marketer ko AI chatbot ke likhe facts aur numbers fact-check kyun karne chahiye?
q.mr: Marketer ने AI chatbot ने लिहिलेले facts आणि आकडे fact-check का करावेत?

en: AI tools are not allowed to write numbers
LLMs can state wrong information confidently
Chatbots always copy text from competitors
Google bans every page that uses AI text
hi: AI tools ko numbers likhne ki permission nahi hai
LLMs galat information bhi confidently bol sakte hain
Chatbots hamesha competitors ka text copy karte hain
Google AI text wale har page ko ban karta hai
mr: AI tools ना आकडे लिहायची परवानगी नाही
LLMs चुकीची माहितीही आत्मविश्वासाने सांगू शकतात
Chatbots नेहमी competitors चा text copy करतात
Google AI text असलेले प्रत्येक page ban करते

exp.en: LLMs predict likely text, so they can produce plausible but false facts, stats or quotes. Google does not ban AI content as such; it cares about helpfulness and accuracy.
exp.hi: LLMs likely text predict karte hain, isliye woh believable lekin galat facts, stats ya quotes bana sakte hain. Google AI content ko as such ban nahi karta; usse helpfulness aur accuracy se matlab hai.
exp.mr: LLMs संभाव्य text predict करतात, त्यामुळे ते पटणारे पण खोटे facts, stats किंवा quotes तयार करू शकतात. Google AI content ला थेट ban करत नाही; त्याला उपयुक्तता आणि अचूकता महत्त्वाची आहे.

q.en: What is a 'deepfake'?
q.hi: 'Deepfake' kya hota hai?
q.mr: 'Deepfake' म्हणजे काय?

en: AI-made media that mimics a real person's face or voice
A fake social media account that has no posts
A hidden keyword stuffed into a website's code
A very long, heavily edited video posted on YouTube
hi: AI se bana media jo real insaan ka face ya voice copy kare
Fake social media account jismein koi post nahi
Website ke code mein chhupa ke bhara gaya keyword
YouTube pe daala gaya bahut lamba, heavily edited video
mr: खऱ्या व्यक्तीचा चेहरा किंवा आवाज नक्कल करणारे AI media
एकही post नसलेले fake social media account
Website च्या code मध्ये लपवून भरलेला keyword
YouTube वर टाकलेला खूप लांब, जास्त edit केलेला video

exp.en: Deepfakes use deep learning to swap or synthesise faces and voices, making someone appear to say or do things they never did. They are a major misinformation and fraud risk.
exp.hi: Deepfakes deep learning se face aur voice swap ya create karte hain, jisse lagta hai ki kisi ne woh bola ya kiya jo usne kabhi nahi kiya. Yeh misinformation aur fraud ka bada risk hai.
exp.mr: Deepfakes deep learning वापरून चेहरे आणि आवाज बदलतात किंवा तयार करतात, ज्यामुळे एखाद्याने कधीच न बोललेले किंवा न केलेले काही केल्यासारखे दिसते. हा misinformation आणि fraud चा मोठा धोका आहे.

q.en: A Pune bakery owner needs 10 Diwali Instagram caption ideas today but has no copywriter. What's the smartest way to use AI?
q.hi: Pune ki ek bakery owner ko aaj hi 10 Diwali Instagram caption ideas chahiye, lekin copywriter nahi hai. AI ka sabse smart use kya hoga?
q.mr: पुण्यातील एका bakery मालकाला आजच 10 Diwali Instagram caption ideas हवे आहेत, पण copywriter नाही. AI चा सर्वात हुशार वापर कोणता?

en: Give an LLM brand details, get options, then edit the best
Copy captions from a big bakery chain's Instagram page
Avoid AI completely, as it cannot write short festive text
Post the first AI answer without reading it, to save time
hi: LLM ko brand details do, options lo, phir best edit karo
Badi bakery chain ke Instagram page se captions copy karo
AI bilkul avoid karo, woh short festive text nahi likh sakta
Time bachane ke liye pehla AI answer bina padhe post karo
mr: LLM ला brand details द्या, पर्याय घ्या, मग सर्वोत्तम edit करा
मोठ्या bakery chain च्या Instagram page वरून captions copy करा
AI पूर्ण टाळा, ते छोटे festive text लिहू शकत नाही
वेळ वाचवण्यासाठी पहिले AI उत्तर न वाचता post करा

exp.en: AI is great for fast first drafts and variants. Giving it context (products, tone, offer) and then editing keeps quality and brand voice. Copying competitors is unoriginal and risky.
exp.hi: AI fast first drafts aur variants ke liye badhiya hai. Context (products, tone, offer) dena aur phir edit karna quality aur brand voice banaye rakhta hai. Competitors ka copy karna unoriginal aur risky hai.
exp.mr: AI जलद first drafts आणि variants साठी उत्तम आहे. Context (products, tone, offer) देऊन मग edit केल्याने quality आणि brand voice टिकतो. Competitors ची copy करणे अनोरिजनल आणि धोकादायक आहे.

q.en: Which marketing task is a classic example of UNSUPERVISED learning?
q.hi: Kaunsa marketing task UNSUPERVISED learning ka classic example hai?
q.mr: कोणते marketing काम UNSUPERVISED learning चे classic उदाहरण आहे?

en: Grouping customers into segments by behaviour without preset labels
Predicting if a lead will convert using past labelled leads
Forecasting next month's sales from labelled history
Scoring emails as spam or not spam from tagged examples
hi: Bina preset labels ke customers ko behaviour ke hisaab se segments mein group karna
Past labelled leads se predict karna ki lead convert hogi ya nahi
Labelled history se agle mahine ki sales forecast karna
Tagged examples se emails ko spam ya not spam batana
mr: आधीच्या labels शिवाय वर्तनानुसार customers चे segments बनवणे
जुन्या labelled leads वरून lead convert होईल का ते predict करणे
Labelled इतिहासावरून पुढच्या महिन्याची sales forecast करणे
Tagged उदाहरणांवरून emails spam आहेत की नाही ते ठरवणे

exp.en: Unsupervised learning finds structure in unlabelled data, e.g. clustering customers into groups you did not define in advance. The other options learn from known answers, which is supervised.
exp.hi: Unsupervised learning bina labels wale data mein patterns dhoondhta hai, jaise customers ko aise groups mein cluster karna jo pehle define nahi kiye the. Baaki options known answers se seekhte hain, woh supervised hai.
exp.mr: Unsupervised learning labels नसलेल्या data मध्ये रचना शोधते, उदा. आधी न ठरवलेल्या गटांमध्ये customers चे clustering. बाकीचे पर्याय माहीत उत्तरांवरून शिकतात, ते supervised आहे.

q.en: What is 'few-shot prompting'?
q.hi: 'Few-shot prompting' kya hai?
q.mr: 'Few-shot prompting' म्हणजे काय?

en: Retraining the model on a few new company documents
Adding a few examples of the desired output to the prompt
Using very short prompts that are just a few words long
Sending a prompt only a few times per day to save cost
hi: Company ke kuch naye documents pe model ko retrain karna
Prompt mein desired output ke kuch examples dena
Sirf kuch words wale bahut chhote prompts use karna
Cost bachane ke liye din mein sirf kuch baar prompt bhejna
mr: कंपनीच्या काही नवीन documents वर model पुन्हा train करणे
Prompt मध्ये अपेक्षित output ची काही उदाहरणे देणे
फक्त काही शब्दांचे खूप छोटे prompts वापरणे
खर्च वाचवण्यासाठी दिवसातून फक्त काही वेळा prompt पाठवणे

exp.en: Few-shot prompting shows the model 2-5 examples (e.g. three past headlines in your brand style) so it copies the pattern. No retraining happens; it all works inside the prompt.
exp.hi: Few-shot prompting mein model ko 2-5 examples dikhaye jaate hain (jaise aapke brand style ki 3 purani headlines) taaki woh pattern follow kare. Koi retraining nahi hoti; sab prompt ke andar hi hota hai.
exp.mr: Few-shot prompting मध्ये model ला 2-5 उदाहरणे दाखवली जातात (उदा. तुमच्या brand style मधील 3 जुन्या headlines) जेणेकरून ते pattern पाळेल. Retraining होत नाही; सगळे prompt मध्येच होते.

q.en: A prompt starts with 'You are an experienced performance marketer for Indian D2C brands.' Which technique is this?
q.hi: Prompt shuru hota hai 'You are an experienced performance marketer for Indian D2C brands.' Yeh kaunsi technique hai?
q.mr: Prompt ची सुरुवात 'You are an experienced performance marketer for Indian D2C brands.' अशी आहे. ही कोणती technique आहे?

en: Negative prompting
Few-shot prompting
Chain-of-thought prompting
Role (persona) prompting
hi: Negative prompting
Few-shot prompting
Chain-of-thought prompting
Role (persona) prompting
mr: Negative prompting
Few-shot prompting
Chain-of-thought prompting
Role (persona) prompting

exp.en: Assigning a role gives the model a perspective, vocabulary and expertise level to write from. Few-shot would need examples; chain-of-thought asks for step-by-step reasoning.
exp.hi: Role dene se model ko ek perspective, vocabulary aur expertise level milta hai. Few-shot mein examples chahiye hote hain; chain-of-thought mein step-by-step reasoning maangi jaati hai.
exp.mr: Role दिल्याने model ला दृष्टिकोन, शब्दसंग्रह आणि expertise level मिळतो. Few-shot मध्ये उदाहरणे लागतात; chain-of-thought मध्ये step-by-step reasoning मागितले जाते.

q.en: What is 'zero-shot' prompting?
q.hi: 'Zero-shot' prompting kya hai?
q.mr: 'Zero-shot' prompting म्हणजे काय?

en: Asking for a task without giving any examples
Deleting the chat history before sending each prompt
A prompt that returns no answer or an empty reply
Running an AI model at zero cost on a free plan
hi: Bina examples diye task karwana
Har prompt bhejne se pehle chat history delete karna
Aisa prompt jiska koi answer ya khaali reply aaye
Free plan pe zero cost mein AI model chalana
mr: उदाहरणे न देता काम करून घेणे
प्रत्येक prompt पाठवण्यापूर्वी chat history delete करणे
ज्याला उत्तर येत नाही किंवा रिकामे reply येते असा prompt
Free plan वर शून्य खर्चात AI model चालवणे

exp.en: Zero-shot means just describing the task ('Classify this review as positive or negative') with no examples. If results are inconsistent, adding examples (few-shot) often helps.
exp.hi: Zero-shot matlab sirf task describe karna ('Is review ko positive ya negative classify karo') bina examples ke. Agar result inconsistent aaye to examples (few-shot) dena aksar help karta hai.
exp.mr: Zero-shot म्हणजे उदाहरणांशिवाय फक्त काम सांगणे ('हा review positive की negative ते सांगा'). Results विसंगत आल्यास उदाहरणे (few-shot) दिल्याने बहुतेक वेळा मदत होते.

q.en: What is an LLM's 'knowledge cutoff'?
q.hi: LLM ka 'knowledge cutoff' kya hota hai?
q.mr: LLM चा 'knowledge cutoff' म्हणजे काय?

en: The time after which an open chat session expires
The point at which it starts refusing unsafe questions
The maximum number of words it can write in one reply
The date after which it has no training data
hi: Woh time jiske baad open chat session expire hota hai
Woh point jahan se woh unsafe sawaal refuse karne lagta hai
Ek reply mein woh maximum kitne words likh sakta hai
Woh date jiske baad ka training data nahi hai
mr: ज्या वेळेनंतर उघडा chat session संपतो ती वेळ
जिथून ते unsafe प्रश्न नाकारायला लागते तो बिंदू
एका उत्तरात ते जास्तीत जास्त किती शब्द लिहू शकते
ज्या तारखेनंतरचा training data नाही ती तारीख

exp.en: A model only 'knows' what was in its training data up to a certain date. For newer facts (prices, trends, algorithm updates) it needs web search or documents you provide.
exp.hi: Model ko sirf utna hi pata hota hai jo ek certain date tak uske training data mein tha. Naye facts (prices, trends, algorithm updates) ke liye use web search ya aapke diye documents chahiye.
exp.mr: Model ला फक्त एका ठराविक तारखेपर्यंतच्या training data मधलेच 'माहीत' असते. नवीन facts (prices, trends, algorithm updates) साठी त्याला web search किंवा तुम्ही दिलेले documents लागतात.

q.en: A brand wants a quick voiceover for a product reel from a written script. Which AI capability fits best?
q.hi: Ek brand ko likhi hui script se product reel ka quick voiceover chahiye. Kaunsi AI capability best fit hai?
q.mr: एका brand ला लिहिलेल्या script वरून product reel साठी झटपट voiceover हवा आहे. कोणती AI capability योग्य आहे?

en: Speech-to-text (transcription)
Text-to-speech (TTS)
Image upscaling
Sentiment analysis
hi: Speech-to-text (transcription)
Text-to-speech (TTS)
Image upscaling
Sentiment analysis
mr: Speech-to-text (transcription)
Text-to-speech (TTS)
Image upscaling
Sentiment analysis

exp.en: Text-to-speech turns written text into natural-sounding audio. Speech-to-text does the reverse (e.g. transcribing a podcast), and sentiment analysis judges emotion in text.
exp.hi: Text-to-speech likhe text ko natural awaaz wale audio mein badalta hai. Speech-to-text ulta kaam karta hai (jaise podcast transcribe karna), aur sentiment analysis text ka emotion judge karta hai.
exp.mr: Text-to-speech लिहिलेला text नैसर्गिक आवाजातील audio मध्ये बदलते. Speech-to-text उलटे काम करते (उदा. podcast transcribe करणे), आणि sentiment analysis text मधील भावना ओळखते.

q.en: A coaching institute in Nagpur wants an AI chatbot on its website to answer questions about fees, batches and timings. What should it do first?
q.hi: Nagpur ka ek coaching institute website pe AI chatbot chahta hai jo fees, batches aur timings ke sawaal answer kare. Pehle kya karna chahiye?
q.mr: नागपूरमधील एका coaching institute ला website वर fees, batches आणि timings बद्दल उत्तरे देणारा AI chatbot हवा आहे. सर्वात आधी काय करावे?

en: Let the bot guess fees based on what similar institutes charge
Launch it without testing and fix parent complaints later
Feed it official fee/batch details and route unknowns to staff
Instruct the bot to promise admission to every student who asks
hi: Bot ko similar institutes ki fees dekh ke guess karne do
Bina testing launch karo aur parents ki complaints baad mein dekho
Official fee/batch details do aur unknown sawaal staff ko bhejo
Bot ko bolo ki poochne wale har student ko admission promise kare
mr: इतर institutes च्या fees पाहून bot ला अंदाज लावू द्या
Testing शिवाय launch करा आणि पालकांच्या तक्रारी नंतर पाहा
अधिकृत fee/batch माहिती द्या आणि अनोळखी प्रश्न staff कडे पाठवा
विचारणाऱ्या प्रत्येक विद्यार्थ्याला admission चे वचन द्यायला bot ला सांगा

exp.en: A chatbot is only as reliable as its source information. Feeding it official, up-to-date details and handing off questions it can't answer prevents made-up fees and angry parents.
exp.hi: Chatbot utna hi reliable hai jitni uski source information. Official, updated details dena aur jo woh answer nahi kar sakta woh staff ko bhejna, galat fees aur naraz parents se bachata hai.
exp.mr: Chatbot त्याच्या source माहितीइतकाच विश्वासार्ह असतो. अधिकृत, अद्ययावत माहिती देणे आणि उत्तर न येणारे प्रश्न staff कडे पाठवणे यामुळे खोट्या fees आणि नाराज पालक टळतात.

q.en: An AI-written blog draft says '72% of Indian shoppers prefer brand X' with no source. What should the content marketer do?
q.hi: AI se likhe blog draft mein likha hai '72% Indian shoppers brand X prefer karte hain' lekin koi source nahi. Content marketer ko kya karna chahiye?
q.mr: AI ने लिहिलेल्या blog draft मध्ये '72% भारतीय shoppers brand X पसंत करतात' असे लिहिले आहे, पण source नाही. Content marketer ने काय करावे?

en: Publish it, since AI tools only quote real survey data
Add 'according to AI research' as the cited source
Round it down to 70% so it sounds less precise
Verify it with a credible primary source, or remove it
hi: Publish karo, AI tools sirf real survey data quote karte hain
Cited source mein 'according to AI research' likh do
Ise 70% kar do taaki kam precise lage
Credible primary source se verify karo, warna hata do
mr: Publish करा, AI tools फक्त खरा survey data सांगतात
Source म्हणून 'according to AI research' लिहा
कमी नेमके वाटावे म्हणून 70% करा
विश्वासार्ह primary source ने तपासा, नाहीतर काढून टाका

exp.en: Unsourced statistics from an LLM may be hallucinated. Publishing them damages trust and can be misleading advertising. Verify against a real survey or report, or cut it.
exp.hi: LLM ke bina source wale statistics hallucinated ho sakte hain. Unhe publish karna trust khatam karta hai aur misleading advertising ban sakta hai. Real survey ya report se verify karo, warna hata do.
exp.mr: LLM ने दिलेली source नसलेली आकडेवारी hallucinated असू शकते. ती publish केल्याने विश्वास तुटतो आणि ती दिशाभूल करणारी जाहिरात ठरू शकते. खऱ्या survey किंवा report मधून तपासा, नाहीतर काढून टाका.

q.en: What is 'chain-of-thought' prompting?
q.hi: 'Chain-of-thought' prompting kya hai?
q.mr: 'Chain-of-thought' prompting म्हणजे काय?

en: Asking the model to reason step by step before answering
Sending the exact same prompt many times in a row
Writing every prompt only as a list of bullet points
Linking several different chatbots together in one sequence
hi: Model se answer se pehle step-by-step reasoning karwana
Bilkul same prompt ko lagatar kai baar bhejna
Har prompt ko sirf bullet points ki list mein likhna
Kai alag chatbots ko ek sequence mein jodna
mr: उत्तरापूर्वी model ला step-by-step विचार करायला सांगणे
अगदी तोच prompt सलग अनेक वेळा पाठवणे
प्रत्येक prompt फक्त bullet points च्या यादीत लिहिणे
अनेक वेगवेगळे chatbots एका क्रमाने जोडणे

exp.en: Chain-of-thought asks the model to work through intermediate steps (e.g. 'first calculate CPA, then compare to target'). This often improves accuracy on maths and multi-step problems.
exp.hi: Chain-of-thought mein model se intermediate steps karwaye jaate hain (jaise 'pehle CPA calculate karo, phir target se compare karo'). Isse maths aur multi-step problems mein accuracy aksar badhti hai.
exp.mr: Chain-of-thought मध्ये model ला मधल्या पायऱ्या करायला सांगितले जाते (उदा. 'आधी CPA काढा, मग target शी तुलना करा'). यामुळे गणित आणि multi-step प्रश्नांमध्ये अचूकता बहुतेक वेळा वाढते.

q.en: Why add 'Reply as a table with columns: Keyword, Intent, Suggested Title' to a prompt?
q.hi: Prompt mein 'Reply as a table with columns: Keyword, Intent, Suggested Title' kyun add karte hain?
q.mr: Prompt मध्ये 'Reply as a table with columns: Keyword, Intent, Suggested Title' का जोडतात?

en: It guarantees every keyword has search volume
It forces the model to use fewer tokens always
It makes the output consistent and easy to reuse
It makes the model search Google live
hi: Har keyword ka search volume guarantee ho jaata hai
Model hamesha kam tokens use karta hai
Output consistent aur reuse karne mein aasaan ho jaata hai
Model Google pe live search karne lagta hai
mr: प्रत्येक keyword ला search volume असल्याची खात्री होते
Model नेहमी कमी tokens वापरते
Output सुसंगत आणि पुन्हा वापरायला सोपे होते
Model Google वर live search करू लागते

exp.en: Specifying the output format gives you predictable structure you can paste into a sheet or tool. It does not add live data; search volumes still need a real keyword tool.
exp.hi: Output format specify karne se predictable structure milta hai jo sheet ya tool mein paste ho sake. Isse live data nahi aata; search volume ke liye real keyword tool chahiye.
exp.mr: Output format सांगितल्याने अंदाज येणारी रचना मिळते जी sheet किंवा tool मध्ये paste करता येते. यामुळे live data येत नाही; search volume साठी खरे keyword tool लागते.

q.en: Your AI-written Google Ads descriptions keep exceeding the 90-character limit and use emojis your brand avoids. Best prompt fix?
q.hi: AI se likhe Google Ads descriptions baar baar 90-character limit cross kar rahe hain aur emojis use kar rahe hain jo brand avoid karta hai. Best prompt fix?
q.mr: AI ने लिहिलेले Google Ads descriptions सतत 90-character मर्यादा ओलांडतात आणि brand टाळत असलेले emojis वापरतात. Prompt मध्ये सर्वोत्तम बदल कोणता?

en: Ask the model to 'be more creative' and just try again
Remove all product context so the model writes less
Add explicit rules: max 90 characters, no emojis; then verify
Switch the prompt language from English to Hindi instead
hi: Model ko 'aur creative bano' bolo aur bas dobara try karo
Saara product context hata do taaki model kam likhe
Explicit rules do: max 90 characters, no emojis; phir verify karo
Iski jagah prompt ki language English se Hindi kar do
mr: Model ला 'अधिक creative हो' सांगा आणि पुन्हा प्रयत्न करा
Model ने कमी लिहावे म्हणून सगळा product context काढा
स्पष्ट नियम द्या: जास्तीत जास्त 90 characters, emojis नको; मग तपासा
त्याऐवजी prompt ची भाषा English वरून Hindi करा

exp.en: Explicit constraints (length, banned words, tone) steer output. Models can still miscount characters, so always verify length before uploading. Removing context just makes copy generic.
exp.hi: Explicit constraints (length, banned words, tone) output ko direct karte hain. Models phir bhi characters galat gin sakte hain, isliye upload se pehle length check karo. Context hatane se copy generic ho jaati hai.
exp.mr: स्पष्ट constraints (लांबी, नको असलेले शब्द, tone) output ला दिशा देतात. Models तरीही characters चुकीचे मोजू शकतात, म्हणून upload आधी लांबी तपासा. Context काढल्याने copy सामान्य होते.

q.en: Predicting whether a website lead will convert (Yes/No) is which type of ML problem?
q.hi: Website lead convert hogi ya nahi (Yes/No) predict karna kaunsa ML problem hai?
q.mr: Website lead convert होईल की नाही (Yes/No) हे predict करणे कोणत्या प्रकारचा ML problem आहे?

en: Clustering
Regression
Text generation
Classification
hi: Clustering
Regression
Text generation
Classification
mr: Clustering
Regression
Text generation
Classification

exp.en: Classification predicts a category (convert / not convert). Regression predicts a number, like expected order value. Clustering groups unlabelled data.
exp.hi: Classification ek category predict karta hai (convert / not convert). Regression number predict karta hai, jaise expected order value. Clustering bina labels ke data ko group karta hai.
exp.mr: Classification एक category predict करते (convert / not convert). Regression एक आकडा predict करते, उदा. अपेक्षित order value. Clustering labels नसलेला data गटांमध्ये विभागते.

q.en: A D2C ghee brand wants 15 headline options for a Google Responsive Search Ad. Which prompt will give the most usable results?
q.hi: Ek D2C ghee brand ko Google Responsive Search Ad ke liye 15 headline options chahiye. Kaunsa prompt sabse usable results dega?
q.mr: एका D2C तूप brand ला Google Responsive Search Ad साठी 15 headline पर्याय हवे आहेत. कोणता prompt सर्वात उपयोगी results देईल?

en: 'Write some ads for our ghee brand, make them good.'
'Copy the headlines used by the top ghee brand online.'
'Write the best ad in the world and make it go viral.'
Product, audience, USPs, tone, 30-char limit, 15 varied angles
hi: 'Hamare ghee brand ke liye kuch achhe ads likho.'
'Online top ghee brand ki headlines copy kar do.'
'Duniya ka best ad likho aur use viral bana do.'
Product, audience, USPs, tone, 30-char limit, 15 alag angles
mr: 'आमच्या तूप brand साठी काही चांगल्या ads लिहा.'
'Online top तूप brand च्या headlines copy करा.'
'जगातील सर्वोत्तम ad लिहा आणि ती viral करा.'
Product, audience, USPs, tone, 30-char मर्यादा, 15 वेगळे angles

exp.en: Good prompts give context (product, audience, USPs), constraints (RSA headlines allow 30 characters) and variety instructions. Vague or hype prompts give generic copy; copying competitors is risky.
exp.hi: Achhe prompts context (product, audience, USPs), constraints (RSA headlines mein 30 characters) aur variety ke instructions dete hain. Vague ya hype prompts generic copy dete hain; competitors copy karna risky hai.
exp.mr: चांगले prompts context (product, audience, USPs), constraints (RSA headlines मध्ये 30 characters) आणि विविधतेच्या सूचना देतात. अस्पष्ट किंवा hype prompts सामान्य copy देतात; competitors ची copy धोकादायक आहे.

q.en: An intern pastes 5,000 customer names and phone numbers into a free public AI chatbot to 'segment' them. What is the main problem?
q.hi: Ek intern 5,000 customers ke naam aur phone numbers free public AI chatbot mein 'segment' karne ke liye paste karta hai. Main problem kya hai?
q.mr: एक intern 5,000 customers ची नावे आणि phone numbers 'segment' करण्यासाठी free public AI chatbot मध्ये paste करतो. मुख्य समस्या काय आहे?

en: Customer segmentation can legally be done only in Excel
Personal data is shared with a third party without safeguards
The chatbot cannot read or process Indian phone numbers
5,000 rows are far too few for any AI tool to segment
hi: Customer segmentation legally sirf Excel mein ho sakta hai
Personal data bina safeguards third party ko share ho gaya
Chatbot Indian phone numbers padh ya process nahi kar sakta
Kisi bhi AI tool ke liye 5,000 rows bahut kam hain
mr: Customer segmentation कायदेशीरपणे फक्त Excel मध्येच करता येते
Personal data safeguards शिवाय third party ला दिला गेला
Chatbot भारतीय phone numbers वाचू किंवा process करू शकत नाही
कोणत्याही AI tool साठी 5,000 rows खूपच कमी आहेत

exp.en: Customer personal data should only go into approved tools with proper data terms, and ideally be anonymised first. Consumer AI apps may store or use inputs, creating privacy and legal risk.
exp.hi: Customer ka personal data sirf approved tools mein jaana chahiye jinke proper data terms hon, aur ideally pehle anonymise karo. Consumer AI apps inputs store ya use kar sakte hain, jisse privacy aur legal risk banta hai.
exp.mr: Customer चा personal data फक्त योग्य data terms असलेल्या approved tools मध्येच जावा, आणि शक्यतो आधी anonymise करावा. Consumer AI apps inputs साठवू किंवा वापरू शकतात, त्यामुळे privacy आणि कायदेशीर धोका निर्माण होतो.

q.en: In an AI chatbot, what is the 'system prompt'?
q.hi: AI chatbot mein 'system prompt' kya hota hai?
q.mr: AI chatbot मध्ये 'system prompt' म्हणजे काय?

en: Background instructions that set the bot's role and rules
The settings panel of the computer's operating system
The error message shown to users when the system crashes
The very first question typed in by the customer
hi: Background instructions jo bot ka role aur rules set karte hain
Computer ke operating system ka settings panel
System crash hone pe users ko dikhne wala error message
Customer ka type kiya hua bilkul pehla sawaal
mr: Bot ची भूमिका आणि नियम ठरवणाऱ्या पार्श्वभूमीतील सूचना
Computer च्या operating system चे settings panel
System crash झाल्यावर users ना दिसणारा error message
Customer ने टाइप केलेला अगदी पहिला प्रश्न

exp.en: The system prompt is set by the business, not the user, e.g. 'You are the support assistant for XYZ Clinic. Answer only from the FAQ. Be polite.' It shapes every reply.
exp.hi: System prompt business set karta hai, user nahi, jaise 'You are the support assistant for XYZ Clinic. Answer only from the FAQ. Be polite.' Yeh har reply ko shape karta hai.
exp.mr: System prompt business ठरवतो, user नाही, उदा. 'You are the support assistant for XYZ Clinic. Answer only from the FAQ. Be polite.' हे प्रत्येक उत्तराला आकार देते.

q.en: A skin clinic's website chatbot told a user 'this cream will cure your eczema in 7 days'. What is the best fix?
q.hi: Ek skin clinic ke website chatbot ne user ko bola 'yeh cream 7 din mein aapka eczema cure kar degi'. Best fix kya hai?
q.mr: एका skin clinic च्या website chatbot ने user ला सांगितले 'हे cream 7 दिवसांत तुमचा eczema बरा करेल'. सर्वोत्तम उपाय कोणता?

en: Add more product names so it recommends more creams per chat
Limit it to general info, block cure claims, hand off to a doctor
Keep it as is, since confident answers increase clinic bookings
Switch off the website's contact form instead of the chatbot
hi: Aur product names add karo taaki har chat mein zyada creams suggest kare
General info tak limit karo, cure claims block karo, doctor ko do
Waisa hi rehne do, confident answers se clinic bookings badhti hain
Chatbot ki jagah website ka contact form band kar do
mr: प्रत्येक chat मध्ये जास्त creams सुचवावीत म्हणून product names जोडा
सामान्य माहितीपुरते मर्यादित करा, cure दावे रोखा, doctor कडे द्या
तसेच ठेवा, आत्मविश्वासपूर्ण उत्तरांनी clinic bookings वाढतात
Chatbot ऐवजी website चा contact form बंद करा

exp.en: Health claims and guaranteed cures are dangerous and can break advertising and medical rules. A healthcare bot needs guardrails in its instructions and a clear route to a qualified doctor.
exp.hi: Health claims aur guaranteed cure dangerous hain aur advertising va medical rules tod sakte hain. Healthcare bot ke instructions mein guardrails aur qualified doctor tak clear route hona chahiye.
exp.mr: आरोग्याचे दावे आणि खात्रीशीर उपचाराचे वचन धोकादायक असून advertising व वैद्यकीय नियम मोडू शकतात. Healthcare bot च्या instructions मध्ये guardrails आणि पात्र doctor कडे स्पष्ट मार्ग हवा.

q.en: Why do LLMs sometimes miscount the letters in a word or the characters in a headline?
q.hi: LLMs kabhi kabhi word ke letters ya headline ke characters galat kyun ginte hain?
q.mr: LLMs कधी कधी शब्दातील अक्षरे किंवा headline मधील characters चुकीचे का मोजतात?

en: They read text as tokens, not single characters
They deliberately add small errors to seem more human
Their internet connection drops while they are counting
They are trained mostly on numbers rather than on words
hi: Woh text ko tokens mein padhte hain, single characters mein nahi
Zyada human lagne ke liye jaan-boojh kar chhoti galtiyan karte hain
Ginte waqt unka internet connection drop ho jaata hai
Woh words ki jagah zyadatar numbers pe train hote hain
mr: ते text tokens मध्ये वाचतात, एकेक character मध्ये नाही
जास्त माणसासारखे वाटावे म्हणून मुद्दाम छोट्या चुका करतात
मोजत असताना त्यांचे internet connection तुटते
ते शब्दांऐवजी मुख्यतः आकड्यांवर train होतात

exp.en: Text is split into tokens (whole words or word pieces), so the model doesn't directly 'see' each letter. That's why you should verify character limits with a counter or code.
exp.hi: Text tokens (poore words ya word pieces) mein split hota hai, isliye model har letter directly 'dekhta' nahi. Isliye character limits ko counter ya code se verify karo.
exp.mr: Text tokens (संपूर्ण शब्द किंवा शब्दांचे तुकडे) मध्ये विभागला जातो, त्यामुळे model प्रत्येक अक्षर थेट 'पाहत' नाही. म्हणून character limits counter किंवा code ने तपासा.

q.en: Many popular image generators are 'diffusion models'. How do they create an image?
q.hi: Kai popular image generators 'diffusion models' hain. Woh image kaise banate hain?
q.mr: अनेक लोकप्रिय image generators 'diffusion models' आहेत. ते image कशी तयार करतात?

en: By drawing only outlines that a designer colours in
By starting from random noise and removing it step by step
By searching Google Images and pasting the best match
By stitching together stock photos from a library
hi: Sirf outlines bana kar jinhe designer colour karta hai
Random noise se shuru karke use step by step hata kar
Google Images search karke best match paste karke
Library ke stock photos ko jod kar
mr: फक्त outlines काढून ज्यात designer रंग भरतो
Random noise पासून सुरुवात करून तो टप्प्याटप्प्याने काढून
Google Images शोधून सर्वात जुळणारे चित्र paste करून
Library मधील stock photos जोडून

exp.en: Diffusion models learn to reverse a noising process: they begin with random noise and gradually 'denoise' it into an image that matches the prompt. They generate new pixels, not copy-paste search results.
exp.hi: Diffusion models noise add karne ke process ko reverse karna seekhte hain: random noise se shuru karke dheere dheere 'denoise' karke prompt jaisi image banate hain. Yeh naye pixels banate hain, search results copy-paste nahi karte.
exp.mr: Diffusion models noise टाकण्याची प्रक्रिया उलटी करायला शिकतात: random noise पासून सुरुवात करून हळूहळू 'denoise' करत prompt ला जुळणारी image बनवतात. ते नवीन pixels तयार करतात, search results copy-paste करत नाहीत.

q.en: Which is a common use of predictive machine learning in marketing analytics?
q.hi: Marketing analytics mein predictive machine learning ka common use kaunsa hai?
q.mr: Marketing analytics मध्ये predictive machine learning चा सामान्य वापर कोणता?

en: Estimating which customers are likely to churn
Choosing the company's registered legal name
Drafting the website's privacy policy from scratch
Designing the colour palette of the brand's new logo
hi: Andaza lagana ki kaunse customers churn kar sakte hain
Company ka registered legal naam choose karna
Website ki privacy policy shuru se draft karna
Brand ke naye logo ka colour palette design karna
mr: कोणते customers सोडून जाण्याची (churn) शक्यता आहे याचा अंदाज
कंपनीचे नोंदणीकृत कायदेशीर नाव निवडणे
Website ची privacy policy सुरुवातीपासून लिहिणे
Brand च्या नवीन logo ची colour palette design करणे

exp.en: Predictive ML uses past behaviour (purchase gaps, app usage, complaints) to score churn risk, lead quality or lifetime value, so you can target retention offers where they matter.
exp.hi: Predictive ML past behaviour (purchase gaps, app usage, complaints) se churn risk, lead quality ya lifetime value score karta hai, taaki retention offers sahi logon ko diye ja sakein.
exp.mr: Predictive ML मागील वर्तन (खरेदीतील अंतर, app वापर, तक्रारी) वापरून churn risk, lead quality किंवा lifetime value चा score देते, जेणेकरून retention offers योग्य लोकांना देता येतील.

q.en: On many LLMs, the same message often uses more tokens in Hindi or Marathi (Devanagari) than in English. Why?
q.hi: Kai LLMs pe same message Hindi ya Marathi (Devanagari) mein English se zyada tokens leta hai. Kyun?
q.mr: अनेक LLMs वर तोच संदेश English पेक्षा Hindi किंवा Marathi (Devanagari) मध्ये जास्त tokens घेतो. का?

en: English-heavy tokenizers split Devanagari into more pieces
The model silently translates everything into English twice
Providers charge Indian languages at a special premium rate
Devanagari sentences always carry more meaning per word
hi: English-heavy tokenizers Devanagari ko zyada pieces mein todte hain
Model chupchaap har cheez ko do baar English mein translate karta hai
Providers Indian languages pe special premium rate lagate hain
Devanagari sentences mein har word ka meaning hamesha zyada hota hai
mr: English-प्रधान tokenizers Devanagari चे जास्त तुकडे करतात
Model गुपचूप सर्वकाही दोनदा English मध्ये translate करते
Providers भारतीय भाषांसाठी विशेष premium दर आकारतात
Devanagari वाक्यांत प्रत्येक शब्दाचा अर्थ नेहमी जास्त असतो

exp.en: Tokenizers learn common chunks from their training text; with less Devanagari data, words break into more tokens. More tokens means higher cost and less room in the context window.
exp.hi: Tokenizers training text se common chunks seekhte hain; Devanagari data kam hone se words zyada tokens mein toot-te hain. Zyada tokens matlab zyada cost aur context window mein kam jagah.
exp.mr: Tokenizers training text मधून सामान्य तुकडे शिकतात; Devanagari data कमी असल्याने शब्द जास्त tokens मध्ये तुटतात. जास्त tokens म्हणजे जास्त खर्च आणि context window मध्ये कमी जागा.

q.en: A Pune clothing D2C brand wants AI-personalised product recommendations in its emails. What is the best foundation?
q.hi: Pune ka clothing D2C brand emails mein AI-personalised product recommendations chahta hai. Sabse achha foundation kya hai?
q.mr: पुण्यातील एका clothing D2C brand ला emails मध्ये AI-personalised product recommendations हव्या आहेत. सर्वोत्तम पाया कोणता?

en: A bulk contact list bought from a third-party data broker
Guessing each shopper's style from their first name alone
Sending every customer the same weekly bestseller list
Consented first-party data: past purchases and site browsing
hi: Third-party data broker se khareedi bulk contact list
Sirf first name se har shopper ka style guess karna
Har customer ko same weekly bestseller list bhejna
Consent wala first-party data: past purchases aur site browsing
mr: Third-party data broker कडून विकत घेतलेली bulk contact list
फक्त पहिल्या नावावरून प्रत्येक shopper ची style अंदाजे ठरवणे
प्रत्येक customer ला तीच साप्ताहिक bestseller list पाठवणे
Consent असलेला first-party data: past purchases आणि site browsing

exp.en: Personalisation works best on relevant, consented first-party behaviour data. Bought lists raise consent problems under India's DPDP Act, and a single list for all is not personalisation.
exp.hi: Personalisation relevant, consent wale first-party behaviour data pe best kaam karta hai. Khareedi hui lists India ke DPDP Act mein consent problems laati hain, aur sabko same list personalisation nahi hai.
exp.mr: Personalisation संबंधित, consent असलेल्या first-party वर्तन data वर सर्वोत्तम चालते. विकत घेतलेल्या lists मुळे भारताच्या DPDP Act अंतर्गत consent च्या समस्या येतात, आणि सर्वांना एकच list म्हणजे personalisation नाही.

q.en: Your team generates an AI image showing a famous cricketer holding your energy drink, for an Instagram ad. He never endorsed you. What should you do?
q.hi: Team ne Instagram ad ke liye AI image banayi jismein ek famous cricketer aapka energy drink pakde hue hai. Usne kabhi endorse nahi kiya. Kya karna chahiye?
q.mr: Team ने Instagram ad साठी एक AI image बनवली ज्यात एक प्रसिद्ध cricketer तुमचे energy drink धरून आहे. त्याने कधीच endorse केलेले नाही. काय करावे?

en: Run it, because AI images are not real photographs
Don't run it: it uses his likeness without consent
Run it and tag the cricketer's name as a hashtag for reach
Run it, but only in regional-language ads to limit reach
hi: Chalao, kyunki AI images real photographs nahi hoti
Mat chalao: yeh bina consent uski likeness use karta hai
Chalao aur reach ke liye cricketer ka naam hashtag mein daalo
Chalao, lekin reach limit karne ke liye sirf regional ads mein
mr: चालवा, कारण AI images खरे photographs नसतात
चालवू नका: हे consent शिवाय त्याचा चेहरा वापरते
चालवा आणि reach साठी cricketer चे नाव hashtag मध्ये टाका
चालवा, पण reach मर्यादित ठेवण्यासाठी फक्त प्रादेशिक ads मध्ये

exp.en: Using a celebrity's likeness without permission misleads consumers into believing an endorsement exists and can violate personality rights and ad platform policies. Being AI-made is no defence.
exp.hi: Celebrity ki likeness bina permission use karna consumers ko mislead karta hai ki endorsement hai, aur personality rights va ad platform policies tod sakta hai. AI-made hona koi bachav nahi hai.
exp.mr: Celebrity चा चेहरा परवानगीशिवाय वापरल्याने endorsement असल्याचा ग्राहकांचा गैरसमज होतो आणि personality rights व ad platform policies मोडू शकतात. AI-निर्मित असणे हा बचाव नाही.

q.en: What does 'grounding' an LLM's answer mean?
q.hi: LLM ke answer ko 'grounding' karna kya hota hai?
q.mr: LLM च्या उत्तराचे 'grounding' करणे म्हणजे काय?

en: Blocking the model from accessing the internet completely
Basing answers on trusted sources like your own documents
Making the model's answers shorter, simpler and friendlier
Retraining the whole model from scratch on fresh data
hi: Model ka internet access poori tarah block karna
Answers ko trusted sources jaise apne documents pe base karna
Model ke answers ko chhota, simple aur friendly banana
Poore model ko fresh data pe shuru se retrain karna
mr: Model चा internet access पूर्णपणे बंद करणे
उत्तरे विश्वासार्ह sources जसे स्वतःच्या documents वर आधारित करणे
Model ची उत्तरे छोटी, सोपी आणि मैत्रीपूर्ण करणे
संपूर्ण model नवीन data वर सुरुवातीपासून retrain करणे

exp.en: Grounding means the model answers based on supplied, verifiable information (e.g. via RAG or web search), ideally with citations. It reduces hallucinations; it does not retrain the model.
exp.hi: Grounding matlab model diye gaye, verifiable information (jaise RAG ya web search se) ke basis pe answer kare, ideally citations ke saath. Isse hallucinations kam hote hain; model retrain nahi hota.
exp.mr: Grounding म्हणजे model दिलेल्या, तपासता येणाऱ्या माहितीच्या आधारे (उदा. RAG किंवा web search द्वारे) उत्तर देते, शक्यतो citations सह. यामुळे hallucinations कमी होतात; model retrain होत नाही.

q.en: A real-estate brand plans an ad with an AI-generated, photo-realistic 'customer' saying she loved her new flat. When is disclosure most important?
q.hi: Ek real-estate brand ek ad plan kar raha hai jismein AI-generated, photo-realistic 'customer' kehti hai ki use naya flat pasand aaya. Disclosure kab sabse zaroori hai?
q.mr: एक real-estate brand अशी ad आखत आहे ज्यात AI-निर्मित, हुबेहूब दिसणारी 'customer' म्हणते की तिला नवीन flat आवडला. Disclosure कधी सर्वात महत्त्वाचे आहे?

en: When viewers could think the fake person is a real buyer
Never, since audiences know all ads are partly fictional
Only when the campaign's ad budget is above ₹1 lakh
Only if the image was generated using a paid AI tool
hi: Jab viewers fake insaan ko real buyer samajh sakte hain
Kabhi nahi, audience jaanti hai ki sab ads thode fictional hain
Sirf jab campaign ka ad budget ₹1 lakh se upar ho
Sirf agar image paid AI tool se generate hui ho
mr: जेव्हा प्रेक्षक खोट्या व्यक्तीला खरा खरेदीदार समजू शकतात
कधीच नाही, सर्व ads थोड्या काल्पनिक असतात हे प्रेक्षकांना माहीत आहे
फक्त campaign चे ad budget ₹1 lakh पेक्षा जास्त असेल तेव्हा
फक्त image paid AI tool ने तयार केली असेल तर

exp.en: A realistic synthetic 'testimonial' can mislead people into thinking it's a genuine customer review. Disclose AI use, or better, use real testimonials. Budget or tool price is irrelevant.
exp.hi: Realistic synthetic 'testimonial' logon ko mislead kar sakta hai ki yeh genuine customer review hai. AI use disclose karo, ya behtar, real testimonials use karo. Budget ya tool ki price se farak nahi padta.
exp.mr: हुबेहूब synthetic 'testimonial' मुळे लोकांना तो खरा customer review वाटू शकतो. AI वापर उघड करा, किंवा त्याहून चांगले, खरे testimonials वापरा. Budget किंवा tool ची किंमत महत्त्वाची नाही.

q.en: A gym owner's prompt 'Write a post about our gym' keeps giving bland, generic posts. What change will help most?
q.hi: Gym owner ka prompt 'Write a post about our gym' baar baar bland, generic posts de raha hai. Sabse zyada kya help karega?
q.mr: एका gym मालकाचा prompt 'Write a post about our gym' सतत नीरस, सामान्य posts देत आहे. सर्वात जास्त काय मदत करेल?

en: Ask for 'the most viral post ever written'
Type the prompt in capital letters for emphasis
Repeat the same prompt until something good appears
Add audience, goal, offer, tone, format and a sample post
hi: 'Ab tak ka sabse viral post' maango
Emphasis ke liye prompt capital letters mein likho
Same prompt tab tak repeat karo jab tak kuch achha na aaye
Audience, goal, offer, tone, format aur ek sample post add karo
mr: 'आजवरची सर्वात viral post' मागा
भर देण्यासाठी prompt capital letters मध्ये लिहा
काहीतरी चांगले येईपर्यंत तोच prompt पुन्हा पुन्हा द्या
Audience, goal, offer, tone, format आणि एक नमुना post जोडा

exp.en: Generic input gives generic output. Specifics like 'women 30-45 in Kothrud, ₹999 trial offer, friendly tone, 3 short lines + CTA' plus an example steer the model to on-brand copy.
exp.hi: Generic input se generic output aata hai. Specifics jaise 'Kothrud ki 30-45 age ki women, ₹999 trial offer, friendly tone, 3 short lines + CTA' aur ek example model ko on-brand copy ki taraf le jaate hain.
exp.mr: सामान्य input मुळे सामान्य output येते. 'कोथरूडमधील 30-45 वयोगटातील महिला, ₹999 trial offer, मैत्रीपूर्ण tone, 3 छोट्या ओळी + CTA' असे तपशील आणि एक उदाहरण model ला on-brand copy कडे नेतात.

q.en: What is 'prompt chaining'?
q.hi: 'Prompt chaining' kya hai?
q.mr: 'Prompt chaining' म्हणजे काय?

en: Stuffing several unrelated questions into a single prompt
Splitting a task into steps, each output feeding the next
Sharing one master prompt with every member of the team
Locking a finished prompt so that nobody else can edit it
hi: Kai unrelated sawaal ek hi prompt mein bhar dena
Task ko steps mein todna, har output agle step mein jaaye
Ek master prompt team ke har member ke saath share karna
Final prompt ko lock karna taaki koi aur edit na kar sake
mr: अनेक असंबंधित प्रश्न एकाच prompt मध्ये भरणे
काम टप्प्यांत विभागणे, प्रत्येक output पुढच्या टप्प्यात जाते
एक master prompt team च्या प्रत्येक सदस्यासोबत share करणे
तयार prompt lock करणे जेणेकरून दुसरे कोणी edit करू शकणार नाही

exp.en: Example chain: 1) summarise customer reviews into pain points, 2) turn pain points into ad angles, 3) write copy per angle. Smaller steps are easier to check and give better results.
exp.hi: Example chain: 1) customer reviews ko pain points mein summarise karo, 2) pain points ko ad angles banao, 3) har angle ke liye copy likho. Chhote steps check karna aasaan hai aur results behtar aate hain.
exp.mr: उदाहरण chain: 1) customer reviews चे pain points मध्ये सारांश, 2) pain points पासून ad angles, 3) प्रत्येक angle साठी copy. छोटे टप्पे तपासणे सोपे असते आणि results चांगले येतात.

q.en: An AI tool used to shortlist marketing job applicants rejects far more women than men with similar skills. What is the most likely cause and response?
q.hi: Marketing job applicants shortlist karne wala AI tool similar skills ke bawajood men se kahin zyada women ko reject kar raha hai. Sabse likely cause aur response kya hai?
q.mr: Marketing job applicants shortlist करणारे AI tool सारखी कौशल्ये असूनही पुरुषांपेक्षा खूप जास्त महिलांना reject करत आहे. सर्वात संभाव्य कारण आणि उपाय काय?

en: There are too many applicants, so just raise the shortlist number
Bias learned from past hiring data; pause, audit, add human review
Women's resumes are usually badly formatted, so ignore the gap
The tool is working correctly, because AI is always neutral
hi: Applicants bahut zyada hain, bas shortlist number badha do
Past hiring data se seekha bias; pause, audit, human review add karo
Women ke resumes aksar badly formatted hote hain, gap ignore karo
Tool sahi kaam kar raha hai, kyunki AI hamesha neutral hota hai
mr: Applicants खूप आहेत, फक्त shortlist संख्या वाढवा
जुन्या hiring data मधून शिकलेला bias; थांबवा, audit करा, human review जोडा
महिलांचे resumes सहसा चुकीच्या format मध्ये असतात, फरक दुर्लक्षित करा
Tool बरोबर काम करत आहे, कारण AI नेहमी तटस्थ असते

exp.en: Models reproduce patterns in their training data, including historical discrimination. 'AI is neutral' is a myth; biased outcomes need auditing, fixing and human oversight.
exp.hi: Models training data ke patterns copy karte hain, historical discrimination bhi. 'AI neutral hota hai' ek myth hai; biased outcomes ko audit, fix aur human oversight chahiye.
exp.mr: Models training data मधले patterns, ऐतिहासिक भेदभावासह, पुन्हा निर्माण करतात. 'AI तटस्थ असते' हा गैरसमज आहे; biased निकालांसाठी audit, दुरुस्ती आणि मानवी देखरेख लागते.

q.en: A Nashik agri-brand wants to clone its founder's voice with AI to make ads in Marathi, Hindi and Gujarati. What's the responsible approach?
q.hi: Nashik ka ek agri-brand founder ki voice AI se clone karke Marathi, Hindi aur Gujarati mein ads banana chahta hai. Responsible approach kya hai?
q.mr: नाशिकमधील एका agri-brand ला founder चा आवाज AI ने clone करून Marathi, Hindi आणि Gujarati मध्ये ads बनवायच्या आहेत. जबाबदार पद्धत कोणती?

en: Also clone a rival founder's voice for comparison ads
Let any employee generate audio with it whenever they like
Clone it quietly from his old videos without asking him first
Get his written consent, secure the model, review every script
hi: Comparison ads ke liye rival founder ki voice bhi clone karo
Koi bhi employee jab chahe isse audio bana sake
Bina pooche chupchaap unke purane videos se clone kar lo
Unka written consent lo, model secure rakho, har script review karo
mr: Comparison ads साठी प्रतिस्पर्धी founder चा आवाजही clone करा
कोणताही कर्मचारी हवे तेव्हा याने audio बनवू शकेल असे करा
न विचारता त्यांच्या जुन्या videos वरून गुपचूप clone करा
त्यांचे लेखी consent घ्या, model सुरक्षित ठेवा, प्रत्येक script तपासा

exp.en: Voice cloning is powerful for regional reach but must be consent-based and access-controlled, since a leaked voice model can be misused for scams. Cloning anyone without consent is unethical and risky.
exp.hi: Voice cloning regional reach ke liye powerful hai, lekin consent-based aur access-controlled hona chahiye, kyunki leak hua voice model scams mein misuse ho sakta hai. Bina consent kisi ki voice clone karna unethical aur risky hai.
exp.mr: Voice cloning प्रादेशिक पोहोचसाठी प्रभावी आहे, पण ते consent-आधारित आणि access-controlled असावे, कारण leak झालेला voice model scams साठी वापरला जाऊ शकतो. Consent शिवाय कोणाचाही आवाज clone करणे अनैतिक आणि धोकादायक आहे.

q.en: In image generators that support it, what is a 'negative prompt' used for?
q.hi: Jo image generators support karte hain, unmein 'negative prompt' kis liye use hota hai?
q.mr: जे image generators support करतात त्यांत 'negative prompt' कशासाठी वापरतात?

en: Listing what you don't want, like text or extra fingers
Writing a deliberately rude prompt to test safety filters
Converting a colour image into a black-and-white version
Making the whole image darker, moodier and more dramatic
hi: Jo nahi chahiye woh list karna, jaise text ya extra fingers
Safety filters test karne ke liye jaan-boojh kar rude prompt likhna
Colour image ko black-and-white version mein badalna
Poori image ko darker, moody aur dramatic banana
mr: जे नको ते सांगणे, जसे text किंवा जास्तीची बोटे
Safety filters तपासण्यासाठी मुद्दाम उद्धट prompt लिहिणे
रंगीत image चे black-and-white version बनवणे
संपूर्ण image अधिक गडद, moody आणि नाट्यमय करणे

exp.en: A negative prompt tells the model what to avoid (e.g. 'blurry, watermark, distorted hands, text'), helping get cleaner ad creatives. It isn't about tone or colour filters.
exp.hi: Negative prompt model ko batata hai kya avoid karna hai (jaise 'blurry, watermark, distorted hands, text'), jisse cleaner ad creatives milte hain. Iska tone ya colour filter se lena-dena nahi.
exp.mr: Negative prompt model ला काय टाळायचे ते सांगतो (उदा. 'blurry, watermark, distorted hands, text'), ज्यामुळे स्वच्छ ad creatives मिळतात. याचा tone किंवा colour filter शी संबंध नाही.

q.en: What does a Google Ads Performance Max campaign do?
q.hi: Google Ads ka Performance Max campaign kya karta hai?
q.mr: Google Ads चे Performance Max campaign काय करते?

en: One campaign where Google's AI serves ads across its channels
Shows your ads only in the very top position on Search
Lets you set a manual bid on every single keyword you add
Runs ads only on partner websites outside Google's own network
hi: Ek campaign jismein Google ka AI saare channels pe ads chalata hai
Aapke ads sirf Search ki sabse top position pe dikhata hai
Har add kiye keyword pe manual bid set karne deta hai
Ads sirf Google network ke bahar partner websites pe chalata hai
mr: एक campaign ज्यात Google चे AI सर्व channels वर ads चालवते
तुमच्या ads फक्त Search च्या अगदी वरच्या जागी दाखवते
जोडलेल्या प्रत्येक keyword वर manual bid ठरवू देते
Ads फक्त Google network बाहेरच्या partner websites वर चालवते

exp.en: Performance Max is goal-based: you give assets, budget, conversion goals and audience signals, and Google's AI decides bids, placements and creative combinations across Search, YouTube, Display, Discover, Gmail and Maps.
exp.hi: Performance Max goal-based hai: aap assets, budget, conversion goals aur audience signals dete ho, aur Google ka AI Search, YouTube, Display, Discover, Gmail aur Maps pe bids, placements aur creative combinations decide karta hai.
exp.mr: Performance Max हे goal-आधारित आहे: तुम्ही assets, budget, conversion goals आणि audience signals देता, आणि Google चे AI Search, YouTube, Display, Discover, Gmail आणि Maps वर bids, placements आणि creative combinations ठरवते.

q.en: You have 800 customer reviews of your mixer-grinder and want AI to find product insights. What's the best approach?
q.hi: Aapke mixer-grinder ke 800 customer reviews hain aur aap AI se product insights nikalna chahte ho. Best approach kya hai?
q.mr: तुमच्या mixer-grinder चे 800 customer reviews आहेत आणि AI कडून product insights हवे आहेत. सर्वोत्तम पद्धत कोणती?

en: Ask the AI to invent extra reviews where feedback is thin
Ask the AI for a single overall star rating and nothing else
Skip AI and read only the five most recent reviews yourself
Get themes with counts and quotes, then spot-check them
hi: Jahan feedback kam hai wahan AI se extra reviews invent karwao
AI se sirf ek overall star rating maango, aur kuch nahi
AI chhodo aur khud sirf 5 latest reviews padho
Counts aur quotes ke saath themes lo, phir spot-check karo
mr: जिथे feedback कमी आहे तिथे AI कडून जास्तीचे reviews तयार करून घ्या
AI कडून फक्त एक एकूण star rating मागा, बाकी काही नाही
AI सोडा आणि स्वतः फक्त 5 नवीनतम reviews वाचा
संख्या आणि quotes सह themes घ्या, मग spot-check करा

exp.en: LLMs are excellent at summarising large text, but grouping themes with supporting quotes lets you verify the insight is real. Spot-checking catches misreadings; inventing reviews is dishonest.
exp.hi: LLMs bade text ko summarise karne mein excellent hain, lekin supporting quotes ke saath themes group karne se aap verify kar sakte ho ki insight real hai. Spot-check galat reading pakadta hai; reviews invent karna beimaani hai.
exp.mr: LLMs मोठा text सारांशित करण्यात उत्कृष्ट आहेत, पण पुराव्याच्या quotes सह themes केल्याने insight खरा आहे हे तपासता येते. Spot-check चुकीचे वाचन पकडतो; reviews तयार करणे अप्रामाणिक आहे.

q.en: Why can the same prompt give a different answer each time you run it?
q.hi: Same prompt har baar run karne pe alag answer kyun de sakta hai?
q.mr: तोच prompt प्रत्येक वेळी चालवल्यावर वेगळे उत्तर का देऊ शकतो?

en: Live internet traffic changes the model's answers
Each next token is sampled from probabilities
Every user is silently given a different model
The model rewrites its training data after every chat
hi: Live internet traffic model ke answers badal deta hai
Har agla token probabilities se sample hota hai
Har user ko chupchaap alag model diya jaata hai
Model har chat ke baad apna training data rewrite karta hai
mr: Live internet traffic model ची उत्तरे बदलते
प्रत्येक पुढचा token probabilities मधून sample होतो
प्रत्येक user ला गुपचूप वेगळे model दिले जाते
Model प्रत्येक chat नंतर स्वतःचा training data पुन्हा लिहिते

exp.en: LLMs pick each token by sampling from likely options, so there is built-in randomness (controlled by settings like temperature). The model's training doesn't change between your chats.
exp.hi: LLMs har token likely options mein se sample karke chunte hain, isliye built-in randomness hoti hai (temperature jaisi settings se control hoti hai). Aapki chats ke beech model ki training nahi badalti.
exp.mr: LLMs प्रत्येक token संभाव्य पर्यायांमधून sample करून निवडतात, त्यामुळे अंगभूत randomness असते (temperature सारख्या settings ने नियंत्रित). तुमच्या chats दरम्यान model चे training बदलत नाही.

q.en: In a very long chat, your AI assistant starts ignoring the brand-tone rules you gave at the start. What's the most likely cause and fix?
q.hi: Bahut lambi chat mein aapka AI assistant shuru mein diye brand-tone rules ignore karne laga. Sabse likely cause aur fix kya hai?
q.mr: खूप लांब chat मध्ये तुमचा AI assistant सुरुवातीला दिलेले brand-tone नियम दुर्लक्षित करू लागला. सर्वात संभाव्य कारण आणि उपाय काय?

en: Brand rules automatically expire after 24 hours of chatting
Context overload; restart with a short brief of key rules
The model is annoyed with you; apologise and carry on
The model needs a faster internet connection to remember
hi: Brand rules 24 ghante chat ke baad automatically expire hote hain
Context overload; key rules ke short brief ke saath restart karo
Model aap se naraz hai; sorry bolo aur aage badho
Yaad rakhne ke liye model ko faster internet chahiye
mr: 24 तास chat नंतर brand नियम आपोआप expire होतात
Context overload; मुख्य नियमांच्या छोट्या brief सह पुन्हा सुरू करा
Model तुमच्यावर चिडले आहे; माफी मागा आणि पुढे चला
लक्षात ठेवण्यासाठी model ला जलद internet हवे

exp.en: Very long conversations can exceed or crowd the context window, so early instructions get less attention or are dropped. Restating key rules or starting fresh with a summary fixes it.
exp.hi: Bahut lambi conversations context window ko bhar ya exceed kar sakti hain, isliye shuruaati instructions pe kam dhyaan jaata hai ya woh drop ho jaate hain. Key rules dobara batana ya summary ke saath fresh start karna fix hai.
exp.mr: खूप लांब संभाषणे context window भरू किंवा ओलांडू शकतात, त्यामुळे सुरुवातीच्या सूचनांकडे कमी लक्ष जाते किंवा त्या गळतात. मुख्य नियम पुन्हा सांगणे किंवा सारांशासह नवीन सुरुवात हा उपाय आहे.

q.en: What is the main idea behind Meta's Advantage+ campaign options?
q.hi: Meta ke Advantage+ campaign options ka main idea kya hai?
q.mr: Meta च्या Advantage+ campaign पर्यायांमागची मुख्य कल्पना काय आहे?

en: All AI is switched off so humans pick every single audience
Ads are shown only to people who already follow your page
Meta's ML automates targeting, placements and creative mixes
Advertisers get full manual control over every single bid
hi: Saara AI band, taaki insaan har ek audience khud chune
Ads sirf unhe dikhte hain jo already aapka page follow karte hain
Meta ka ML targeting, placements aur creative mixes automate karta hai
Advertisers ko har ek bid pe full manual control milta hai
mr: सर्व AI बंद, जेणेकरून माणसे प्रत्येक audience स्वतः निवडतील
Ads फक्त आधीच तुमचे page follow करणाऱ्यांनाच दिसतात
Meta चे ML targeting, placements आणि creative mixes automate करते
Advertisers ना प्रत्येक bid वर पूर्ण manual नियंत्रण मिळते

exp.en: Advantage+ shifts decisions from manual settings to Meta's AI, which finds audiences and combinations likely to convert. Advertisers mainly supply strong creative, a budget and good conversion data.
exp.hi: Advantage+ decisions ko manual settings se Meta ke AI pe shift karta hai, jo convert hone wali audiences aur combinations dhoondhta hai. Advertisers mainly strong creative, budget aur achha conversion data dete hain.
exp.mr: Advantage+ निर्णय manual settings कडून Meta च्या AI कडे सोपवते, जे convert होण्याची शक्यता असलेल्या audiences आणि combinations शोधते. Advertisers मुख्यतः मजबूत creative, budget आणि चांगला conversion data देतात.

q.en: A startup wants to use a purely AI-generated image, unchanged, as its official logo and trademark. What's the key risk to flag?
q.hi: Ek startup ek purely AI-generated image, bina change kiye, apne official logo aur trademark ki tarah use karna chahta hai. Kaunsa key risk flag karna chahiye?
q.mr: एका startup ला पूर्णपणे AI-निर्मित image, कोणताही बदल न करता, अधिकृत logo आणि trademark म्हणून वापरायची आहे. कोणता मुख्य धोका सांगावा?

en: AI images cannot be exported in PNG or SVG logo formats
Search engines refuse to index any website with an AI logo
Logos made with AI automatically belong to the AI company
Copyright in purely AI work is uncertain; it may resemble marks
hi: AI images PNG ya SVG logo formats mein export nahi hoti
Search engines AI logo wali kisi bhi website ko index nahi karte
AI se bane logos automatically AI company ke ho jaate hain
Purely AI work pe copyright uncertain hai; existing marks jaisa ho sakta hai
mr: AI images PNG किंवा SVG logo formats मध्ये export होत नाहीत
Search engines AI logo असलेली कोणतीही website index करत नाहीत
AI ने बनवलेले logos आपोआप AI कंपनीच्या मालकीचे होतात
पूर्ण AI कामावरील copyright अनिश्चित; ते आधीच्या marks सारखे असू शकते

exp.en: In several jurisdictions (e.g. the US Copyright Office's position), works without meaningful human authorship may not get copyright. Have a designer substantially shape the logo and run a trademark search.
exp.hi: Kai jurisdictions mein (jaise US Copyright Office ki position), bina meaningful human authorship wale works ko copyright nahi mil sakta. Designer se logo ko substantially shape karwao aur trademark search karo.
exp.mr: अनेक देशांमध्ये (उदा. US Copyright Office ची भूमिका), अर्थपूर्ण मानवी योगदान नसलेल्या कामांना copyright मिळू शकत नाही. Designer कडून logo ला मोठ्या प्रमाणात आकार द्या आणि trademark search करा.

q.en: Your boss asks whether AI-written email subject lines beat your copywriter's. What's the fairest way to find out?
q.hi: Boss poochta hai ki kya AI-written email subject lines copywriter ki lines se better hain. Pata karne ka sabse fair tareeka kya hai?
q.mr: Boss विचारतो की AI ने लिहिलेल्या email subject lines copywriter पेक्षा चांगल्या आहेत का. हे शोधण्याचा सर्वात योग्य मार्ग कोणता?

en: Ask the AI tool itself which subject lines it thinks are better
Let the team vote on which subject lines sound more exciting
Send AI lines on Monday and human lines on Saturday, then compare
Random split of one list, same send time, preset metric
hi: AI tool se hi poocho ki usko kaunsi subject lines better lagti hain
Team vote kare ki kaunsi subject lines zyada exciting lagti hain
AI lines Monday ko aur human lines Saturday ko bhejo, phir compare karo
Ek list ka random split, same send time, pehle se set metric
mr: AI tool लाच विचारा की त्याला कोणत्या subject lines चांगल्या वाटतात
कोणत्या subject lines जास्त आकर्षक वाटतात यावर team मत देईल
AI lines सोमवारी आणि human lines शनिवारी पाठवा, मग तुलना करा
एका list चा random split, तीच send time, आधी ठरलेला metric

exp.en: A controlled A/B test isolates the one difference (who wrote the line). Different days, opinions or the AI judging itself all add bias. Choose the metric (e.g. click rate) before the test.
exp.hi: Controlled A/B test sirf ek difference (line kisne likhi) ko isolate karta hai. Alag din, opinions ya AI ka khud ko judge karna sab bias laate hain. Metric (jaise click rate) test se pehle choose karo.
exp.mr: नियंत्रित A/B test फक्त एक फरक (line कोणी लिहिली) वेगळा करतो. वेगवेगळे दिवस, मते किंवा AI ने स्वतःला judge करणे यात bias येतो. Metric (उदा. click rate) test आधीच निवडा.

q.en: A lead-scoring model is 98% accurate on its training data but performs poorly on new leads. What is this called?
q.hi: Ek lead-scoring model training data pe 98% accurate hai lekin naye leads pe kharab perform karta hai. Ise kya kehte hain?
q.mr: एक lead-scoring model training data वर 98% अचूक आहे पण नवीन leads वर खराब चालते. याला काय म्हणतात?

en: Underfitting
Grounding
Overfitting
Tokenization
hi: Underfitting
Grounding
Overfitting
Tokenization
mr: Underfitting
Grounding
Overfitting
Tokenization

exp.en: Overfitting means the model memorised quirks of its training data instead of general patterns. Underfitting is the opposite: it performs poorly even on the training data.
exp.hi: Overfitting matlab model ne general patterns ki jagah training data ki quirks yaad kar li. Underfitting ulta hai: model training data pe bhi kharab perform karta hai.
exp.mr: Overfitting म्हणजे model ने सर्वसाधारण patterns ऐवजी training data मधील वैशिष्ट्ये पाठ केली. Underfitting उलट आहे: model training data वरही खराब चालते.

q.en: A coaching institute's lead-scoring model, trained on 2019-2021 leads, has grown steadily less accurate since students moved to online and Instagram-first enquiries. Best action?
q.hi: Ek coaching institute ka lead-scoring model, jo 2019-2021 ke leads pe trained hai, students ke online aur Instagram-first enquiries pe shift hone ke baad se lagataar kam accurate ho gaya hai. Best action?
q.mr: 2019-2021 च्या leads वर trained असलेले एका coaching institute चे lead-scoring model, विद्यार्थी online आणि Instagram-first चौकशीकडे वळल्यापासून सतत कमी अचूक होत आहे. सर्वोत्तम कृती?

en: Add even more 2019 data so the model becomes more confident
Data drift; retrain on recent leads and keep monitoring
Scrap lead scoring and call every lead in random order
Keep using it, because older data is always more reliable
hi: Aur 2019 ka data daalo taaki model zyada confident ho jaaye
Data drift; recent leads pe retrain karo aur monitor karte raho
Lead scoring hatao aur har lead ko random order mein call karo
Use karte raho, kyunki purana data hamesha zyada reliable hai
mr: Model जास्त confident व्हावे म्हणून आणखी 2019 चा data टाका
Data drift; अलीकडच्या leads वर retrain करा आणि monitor करत राहा
Lead scoring बंद करा आणि प्रत्येक lead ला random क्रमाने call करा
वापरत राहा, कारण जुना data नेहमी जास्त विश्वासार्ह असतो

exp.en: When customer behaviour changes, patterns learned from old data stop holding: that's drift. Models need retraining on fresh data and ongoing monitoring, not more outdated data.
exp.hi: Jab customer behaviour badalta hai, purane data se seekhe patterns kaam nahi karte: yahi drift hai. Models ko fresh data pe retraining aur ongoing monitoring chahiye, aur purana data nahi.
exp.mr: Customer चे वर्तन बदलले की जुन्या data मधून शिकलेले patterns लागू होत नाहीत: हेच drift. Models ना नव्या data वर retraining आणि सतत monitoring लागते, जास्त जुना data नाही.

q.en: Your D2C brand's support chatbot gives different refund timelines to different customers (5, 7 or 10 days). Actual policy is 7 days. Best fix?
q.hi: Aapke D2C brand ka support chatbot alag customers ko alag refund timelines (5, 7 ya 10 din) bata raha hai. Actual policy 7 din hai. Best fix?
q.mr: तुमच्या D2C brand चा support chatbot वेगवेगळ्या customers ना वेगवेगळे refund कालावधी (5, 7 किंवा 10 दिवस) सांगतो. खरी policy 7 दिवस आहे. सर्वोत्तम उपाय?

en: Let the bot pick whichever timeline keeps the customer happiest
Add a note that the bot is only for entertainment purposes
Ground it in the policy text, reduce randomness, test it
Raise the temperature so the answers sound more natural
hi: Bot woh timeline chune jisse customer sabse zyada khush ho
Note laga do ki bot sirf entertainment ke liye hai
Policy text pe ground karo, randomness kam karo, test karo
Temperature badhao taaki answers zyada natural lagein
mr: Customer सर्वात जास्त खूश होईल तो कालावधी bot ला निवडू द्या
Bot फक्त मनोरंजनासाठी आहे अशी सूचना लावा
Policy text वर ground करा, randomness कमी करा, test करा
उत्तरे अधिक नैसर्गिक वाटावीत म्हणून temperature वाढवा

exp.en: Inconsistent facts mean the bot is guessing. Supplying the exact policy, reducing sampling randomness and running a fixed test set of policy questions makes answers accurate and repeatable.
exp.hi: Inconsistent facts ka matlab bot guess kar raha hai. Exact policy dena, sampling randomness kam karna aur policy questions ka fixed test set chalana answers ko accurate aur repeatable banata hai.
exp.mr: विसंगत माहिती म्हणजे bot अंदाज लावत आहे. नेमकी policy देणे, sampling randomness कमी करणे आणि policy प्रश्नांचा ठराविक test set चालवणे यामुळे उत्तरे अचूक आणि सातत्यपूर्ण होतात.

q.en: In a document-based (RAG) assistant, which instruction best reduces made-up answers?
q.hi: Document-based (RAG) assistant mein kaunsa instruction made-up answers sabse zyada kam karta hai?
q.mr: Document-आधारित (RAG) assistant मध्ये कोणती सूचना बनावट उत्तरे सर्वात जास्त कमी करते?

en: 'Make every answer longer, richer and more detailed than before.'
'Use your general knowledge first and the documents second.'
'Use only the given documents; if it's not there, say so.'
